_review: Phase 9 D10: the Long Walker's line (docs/gameplay-design.md §5.1, dunes-design.md §4.3–4.4). D11 adds the camp, the instruments and the side sites; until then this is the erg's main line on its own.
title: The Glass Dunes

quests.title: Follow the Glass
quests.summary: Footprints of glass, each as long as a house, cross the erg in a great loop. Something walked here, and the sand fused under it.

steps.journal: Follow the glass footprints across the erg. They lead toward the great star dune.

The Long Walker walks its old circuit. Make it stumble: change the ground where a foot will land — a Ridge under it, a Bloom's pit, or sand bound hard with Frost. Then climb its kneeling leg onto its back.
Steer the Long Walker home to the dry well at the Wellhouse, west round the Stride: a Shard against a glyph pillar on its back turns it to that side. At the well, light the shaft.
